title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and exposing private data, report says | TechCrunch
summary: Meta employees have raised concerns that the company’s AI agent Muse has been mixing up conversations across different accounts and exposing private user data, according to a new Reuters report that looked at internal company posts.
